title: Conveyor belt length
description: Essential: Correctly calculates L₁ = v₀²/(2a₁) using the given acceleration a₁ and obtains 3.2 m.

title: Wooden board length
description: Essential: Correctly calculates L₂ = v₀²/(2|a₂|) using the deceleration a₂ on the board and obtains 1.33 m (or 4/3 m).

title: Total time A to D
description: Essential: Correctly sums the time on the belt (Δt₁ = v₀/a₁) and the time on the board (Δt₂ = v₀/|a₂|) to obtain T ≈ 2.27 s (or 34/15 s).

title: Acceleration directions
description: Important: Correctly identifies the direction of friction relative to motion for both segments (up the belt, down the board) when applying Newton's second law.

title: Infinite series setup
description: Important: Recognizes the motion after D is an infinite geometric series of up/down segments on the board and sets up the ratio k = a₃/|a₂| correctly.

title: Total sliding distance
description: Important: Correctly sums the infinite series to find the total distance S traveled on the board after D, obtaining 6.67 m (or 20/3 m).

title: Sign error in friction
description: Pitfall: Uses the wrong sign for friction force on the wooden board during upward or downward motion, leading to incorrect acceleration.

title: Velocity condition at B
description: Important: States that the object is at rest relative to the belt at B, meaning its velocity relative to ground is v₀ = 4 m/s up the incline.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s²) throughout the calculation and reports final answers with correct units.

title: Geometric series sum formula
description: Optional: Correctly applies the formula for the sum of an infinite geometric series, S = a/(1 - r), for the distance calculation.
